title: How Deciding Before You're Tempted Builds a Man Who Runs His Own Life
caption:
Willpower loses most of its fights at the moment of temptation, because that's the worst possible time to decide anything.

Daniel resolved not to defile himself before the test ever showed up. The decision came first. By the time the king's food was on the table, there was nothing left to negotiate.

Make the call now, in the boring hour, so you don't have to make it later in the dangerous one.

#faith #discipline #selfcontrol #christianmen #manofgod
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
